sam.price: Quick sync — BigBank POC. They want: streaming responses, function/tool-calling, and strictly validated structured JSON output. Also SOC2 + SSO must be in scope. Can we confirm blockers before Monday's exec call?
maria.se: Thanks. Main asks: dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs), SSO (SAML), and encryption-at-rest with customer KMS. Pricing: they want committed monthly pricing tiers.
liam.sre: From infra side we can provision a Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for the pilot. Need an order of magnitude on qps and max seq length to size nodes.
sam.price: Ballpark — 150 rps steady, bursts to 800 rps during batch runs, typical seq 1024 tokens.
maria.se: Noted. For structured output they want schema-first validation (JSON Schema) and strict error if model deviates. Is there an easy way to enforce that in the SDK or runtime?
nina.devrel: Yes — you can use the structured output/formatting flag + the schema validator at the gateway. Example snippet we give POCs: ```js
const resp = await redwood.generate({
  model: 'redwood/rt-large',
  input: prompt,
  structured_schema: mySchema,
  require_valid: true, // runtime rejects non-conforming outputs
  stream: true,
});
for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) {
  // each chunk is partial json text that will validate end-to-end
}
```
sam.price: Nice. Any caveats for streaming + schema validation?
nina.devrel: Two: 1) partial chunks may be non-JSON until stream end — we buffer incremental tokens and run incremental parse heuristics; we fail early only if final output doesn't match schema. 2) Function/tool-call embedding: tool outputs are injected as structured fields; ensure tool return types are included in the schema.
liam.sre: For Dedicated sizing — 150 steady / 800 burst with 1k seq -> recommend 4 x A100-equivalent nodes with autoscale to 8 for burst; we can add prefix caching to cut token cost ~35%.
maria.se: Pricing ask: can we provide a committed monthly price with discounts for reserved nodes + overage rate? Sales needs a quote range today.
sam.price: Put together a quick bracket we can present: reserved pool (4 nodes) = $X/month, burst buffer to 8 nodes = $Y/month (pay-as-you-go for bursts), per-token rates for embeds/generation, and a SOC2+private KMS add-on fee.
alex.prod: I'll draft numbers — need expected token/month. Use average token yield per request = 600 tokens * 150 rps * 3600 * 24 * 30 ? that's obviously huge — use active concurrency instead. Sam, can you confirm expected daily active minutes or calls?
sam.price: Sorry — realistic: 150 rps for 8 hours daily vs low-night usage. Approx 4.3M requests/month. Use 600 tokens/request average.
alex.prod: OK. Draft quote ready, pinging legal for SOC2/KMS contract addendum.
security-bot: Heads-up: security questionnaire from BigBank requires answers to encryption key rotation, HSM integration, and audit log retention 7 years. We need SOC2 attestation copy and docs for dedicated environment network diagram.
maria.se: I'll attach our SOC2 cert and network diagram to the questionnaire. Liam, can you export dedicated VPC diagram + flow for audit?
liam.sre: On it. ETA EOD tomorrow.
nina.devrel: For their engineers: quick SDK runbook for the POC (to include in handoff): 1) install SDK; 2) set up ephemeral creds; 3) sample streaming + function-call example; 4) JSON schema file; 5) telemetry (trace id mapping). I can package as a gist.
sam.price: Perfect. Any enterprise blockers we should flag now?
maria.se: SAML SSO mapping for 3rd-party roles (we support SCIM + SAML), dedicated audit logs export to their SIEM (via secure forwarder), and data residency in eu-west-1.
liam.sre: Also watch for high tail latency during bursts — add canary traffic and circuit-breaker policy to the rollout.
sam.price: Great. Action items: Alex — draft pricing bracket and contract notes (today), Nina — SDK runbook + sample code (tomorrow morning), Liam — network diagram + sizing (EOD tomorrow), Maria — attach SOC2 & start security questionnaire.
All: any blockers on timelines?
maria.se: No blockers from my side.
liam.sre: None, but need confirmation on exact burst qps on Monday to finalize autoscaling knobs.
nina.devrel: I'll have the gist by 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
alex.prod: Will share draft quote by 16:00 UTC today.
sam.price: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll prep slides and the exec summary for Monday.
